faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about ECAPFX’s trading programs and funding opportunities.

whatIsECAPFX.question: What is ECAPFX?
whatIsECAPFX.answer: ECAPFX is a proprietary trading firm that provides traders with access to funded capital after successfully completing a challenge. We combine performance-based funding with a commitment to positive global impact, donating 1% of annual profits to sustainability initiatives.

challengeTypes.question: What types of challenges do you offer?
challengeTypes.answer: We offer three structured challenge types designed for different levels of trading experience: Beginner – For those new to trading, Experienced – For traders with moderate experience, Seasoned – For professional and high-performance traders. Each structure comes with its own risk parameters, targets, and evaluation metrics.

evaluationCriteria.question: What are the evaluation criteria?
evaluationCriteria.answer: To pass a challenge, you must stay within the following rules: Daily Loss Limit, Max Drawdown, Profit Targets, Consistency Rules based on the type of challenge (Phased or Instant), Trailing Drawdown for Instant accounts, measured with precision.

fundingTime.question: How long does it take to get funded?
fundingTime.answer: After you pass the evaluation and complete KYC/AML compliance checks, we aim to provide access to your funded account within 5 calendar days.

profitSplit.question: What is the profit split?
profitSplit.answer: Your profit share depends on the challenge type and account tier selected. Details are clearly outlined before you start the challenge.

keepProfits.question: Do I keep my profits?
keepProfits.answer: Yes — funded traders receive a profit share from the earnings they generate, based on their selected model.

prohibitedPractices.question: What are prohibited practices?
prohibitedPractices.answer: We strictly prohibit strategies such as: Copy trading, High-frequency arbitrage, News exploitation, Any form of system abuse. Please review the full list on our Rules Page.

ruleBreaks.question: What happens if I break the rules?
ruleBreaks.answer: Rule violations may lead to disqualification or termination of your funded account. We encourage all traders to read and understand our guidelines before participating.

uniqueDifference.question: What makes ECAPFX different from other prop firms?
uniqueDifference.answer: At ECAPFX, we stand against cheap gimmicks and misleading promotions. We don’t offer shallow discounts or flashy marketing tricks just to drive volume. Our focus is on meaningful challenges that develop real traders, not short-term hype. We’re here to support long-term growth, accountability, and impact — both in trading and the world beyond.

supportedPlatforms.question: What platforms do you support?
supportedPlatforms.answer: We currently offer Match-Trader as our trading platform, available on both web and mobile for seamless trading across devices.

supportHours.question: What are your support hours?
supportHours.answer: Our support team is available 24/7 to assist you with any questions or technical issues. Whether you're just starting or actively trading, we’re always here to help.

givingBack.question: How does ECAPFX give back?
givingBack.answer: After your first successful year of trading, ECAPFX donates 1% of firm profits to sustainability-focused projects. It’s our way of aligning trading success with a greater purpose.

gettingStarted.question: How do I get started?
gettingStarted.answer: Sign up at ecapfx.com, choose the challenge that matches your level, and begin your evaluation. You’ll be guided through every step of the journey.

contact.description: At ECAPFX, we are dedicated to providing top-tier support and guidance to our trading community. Contact us for inquiries, partnership opportunities, or assistance with your trading journey.
contact.supportMessage: We are committed to ensuring your success in the financial markets. Whether you need help with account management, trading strategies, or general support, we are here to assist you every step of the way.

rules.title: ECAPFX Prohibited Practices
rules.description: At ECAPFX, we are committed to protecting the integrity of our challenges, our traders, and the firm. The following practices are strictly prohibited.

finalNote.heading: ⚠️ Final Note
finalNote.text: By participating in any ECAPFX challenge or funded program, you agree to abide by these rules. Ignorance is not an excuse. Review the Terms & Conditions and contact our 24/7 support team for clarification.

outsourcingChallenge.title: Outsourcing Your Challenge
outsourcingChallenge.description: You must complete the trading challenge yourself. Paying a third party, using trade services, or hiring someone else to pass the challenge on your behalf is strictly forbidden.

copyTrading.title: Copy Trading / Signal Mirroring
copyTrading.description: Using any form of: Copy trading platforms, Social signal services, Trade replication software, Manual mirroring of trades from other accounts is not allowed.

highFrequencyArbitrage.title: High-Frequency Arbitrage / Tick Scalping
highFrequencyArbitrage.description: Using latency arbitrage, tick scalping (ultra-fast entries/exits within seconds), or exploiting broker execution delays is a violation.

accountSharing.title: Account Sharing or Third-Party Access
accountSharing.description: Only the registered trader may access and operate the account. ECAPFX reserves the right to disqualify any trader if we believe someone else is in control of the account or unauthorised activity is taking place.

platformExploits.title: Platform or Pricing Exploits
platformExploits.description: Abusing pricing errors, execution glitches, or misusing software bugs is prohibited. Trades must reflect fair, legitimate market behaviour.

newsEventGambling.title: News Event Gambling
newsEventGambling.description: Placing oversized trades before or during major economic news releases, with the intent of capitalising on unpredictable volatility, is not allowed.

expertAdvisors.title: Use of Expert Advisors (EAs) or Bots
expertAdvisors.description: Automated systems, bots, or EAs are not allowed unless specifically authorised by ECAPFX in writing.

teamTrading.title: Team/Group Trading
teamTrading.description: Coordinating with others to influence positions, hedge across multiple ECAPFX accounts, or replicate trades is strictly forbidden.

roundTripScalping.title: Round-Trip Scalping / Spread Exploitation
roundTripScalping.description: Trades placed solely to benefit from short-term spreads or commission loopholes — with no market intent — are disallowed.

tradingLimitsManipulation.title: Breach of Trading Limits via Manipulation
tradingLimitsManipulation.description: Passing or failing a challenge by manipulating lot sizes, timing, or open PnL to avoid hitting drawdown rules or to force target completion will result in disqualification.

falseIdentity.title: False Identity or Fake KYC/AML
falseIdentity.description: Submitting fraudulent identification documents or impersonating another person will result in a permanent ban and may trigger legal action.

gamblingBehaviour.title: Gambling Behaviour & Excessive Risk-Taking
gamblingBehaviour.description: If we detect substantial profits gained through reckless, inconsistent, or gambling-like behaviour, ECAPFX reserves the right to investigate or revoke payout eligibility — even if technical rules have not been broken.

consistencyRule.title: Consistency Rule (Discretionary Enforcement)
consistencyRule.description: While our Consistency Rule may not be enforced during your challenge, ECAPFX reserves the right to enforce it at the payout stage. If we believe the strategy used to pass the challenge or generate profits is inconsistent, manipulated, or violates the spirit of sustainable trading, we may: Withhold or adjust payouts, Request further verification, Disqualify the account.

misleadingConduct.title: Misleading Conduct or Fraudulent Intent
misleadingConduct.description: Any attempt to mislead ECAPFX, evade our systems, or abuse trust will result in immediate account termination.

breachedAccountRules.title: Breached Account Rules
breachedAccountRules.description: If your account breaches any of the following limits or rules, ECAPFX reserves the right to take immediate action, including but not limited to: Daily Loss Limit, Overall (Max) Loss Limit, Profit Loss Limit, Days Trading Limit. Actions may include: Immediate disqualification from the challenge or funded program, Termination of your funded trading account without prior notice, Forfeiture of any pending profits or payouts, Permanent ban from future ECAPFX challenges and funding opportunities, Reporting to relevant authorities in cases of fraud or legal violations.

introduction.title: 15.1 Introduction
introduction.text: ECAPFX is an educational trading evaluation platform that provides traders with access to simulated (demo) trading accounts. Our platform is designed exclusively for the development, assessment, and demonstration of trading skills in a risk-free environment.

scope.title: 15.2 Scope
scope.text: This AML Policy applies to all ECAPFX employees, contractors, and associated personnel. It outlines the company’s approach to Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF) in relation to its operations.

businessModel.title: 15.3 Business Model and Nature of Services
items: ECAPFX does not accept, hold, or manage any client funds.
ECAPFX does not provide financial advice, investment recommendations, or manage real capital.
All trading activities on the ECAPFX platform occur in a simulated, risk-free environment using demo accounts only.
ECAPFX operates strictly for educational and evaluation purposes.

regulatoryStatus.title: 15.4 AML Regulatory Status
regulatoryStatus.text: Given the nature of ECAPFX’s services, the company is not subject to the regulatory obligations typically imposed on financial institutions or entities that handle real client funds or conduct actual financial transactions. This includes, but is not limited to:
items: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements beyond those outlined in Section 14
Transaction monitoring for suspicious activity.
Reporting of suspicious activity to financial intelligence units (FIUs).
Sanctions screening and risk assessments.

compliance.title: 15.5 Commitment to Compliance
compliance.text: While ECAPFX is not obligated to implement formal AML controls due to the absence of real fund handling, the company remains committed to:
items: Maintaining transparency in all business operations.
Ensuring legal and regulatory compliance in all applicable areas.
Monitoring regulatory developments that may affect the business model or obligations.
Implementing a comprehensive AML program immediately should the business model evolve to include handling of real client funds or financial transactions.

futurePolicy.title: 15.6 Future AML Policy Implementation
futurePolicy.text: Should ECAPFX expand or modify its business operations to include the acceptance, management, or processing of client funds, the company will:
items: Develop and implement a full AML/CTF compliance program in line with relevant regulations.
Conduct appropriate customer due diligence (CDD) and ongoing monitoring.
Appoint a Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) responsible for AML compliance.
Provide AML training and awareness to all staff members.

policyDevelopment.title: 15.7 Policy Development and Support
policyDevelopment.text: This AML Policy has been developed with the support of a private company that supplies ECAPFX with its Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform. This partnership assists ECAPFX in maintaining and implementing compliance best practices aligned with industry standards.

conclusion.title: 15.8 Conclusion

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.text1: ECAPFX Proprietary Firm ("ECAPFX", "we", "our", or "us") uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance the functionality, security, and personalization of our website
introduction.text2: . This Cookie Policy explains how we use cookies, what types of cookies we use, and how you can manage your cookie preferences.

operator.title: 2. Website Operator
operator.text1: The operator of the website is ECAPFX Proprietary Firm, with its registered office at Office 7330MO 182-184, High Street North Area 1/1, East Ham, London, E6 2JA, UK.

whatAreCookies.title: 3. What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us improve website functionality, analyze usage, and personalize your experience.

typesOfCookies.title: 4. Types of Cookies We Use
typesOfCookies.text: We use the following types of cookies:

necessary.title: a) Necessary Cookies
items: Enable core website functionality, such as navigation and access to secure areas.
Cannot be disabled as they are essential for the website to operate.

analytical.title: b) Analytical Cookies
items: Help us understand how visitors use our website, e.g., which pages are visited most.
Optional and used only with your consent.

marketing.title: c) Marketing Cookies
items: Used to personalize advertisements and content across websites and social media.
Optional and used only with your consent.

cookieManagement.title: 5. How to Manage Cookies
cookieManagement.text1: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings or our cookie consent banner. Most browsers accept cookies by default, but you can:
items: Accept all cookies.
Reject non-essential cookies.
Delete cookies from your device at any time.
cookieManagement.text2: For more information, see your browser’s help section or operating system settings. Note that rejecting cookies may affect some website features.

thirdPartyCookies.title: 6. Third-Party Cookies
thirdPartyCookies.text: Some cookies may be set by third-party services (e.g., analytics or advertising partners). These are subject to the privacy policies of those providers.

yourRights.title: 7. Your Rights
yourRights.text: Under UK GDPR, you have the right to:
items: Access data we hold about you via cookies.
Object to or restrict cookie-related data processing.
Withdraw consent for non-essential cookies at any time.
Lodge a complaint with the UK Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) at https://ico.org.uk/
